The master asks slave 1 to "Write Multiple Registers": write 2 registers starting from 40001

── Data details ──
40001 = 10 (0x000A)
40002 = 257 (0x0101)

── Byte-by-byte ──
01           Slave address   device 1
10           Function code   0x10 = Write Multiple Registers
00 00        Start address   protocol address 0, PLC address 40001
00 02        Write quantity  write 2 registers
04           Byte count      4 bytes of write data
00 0A 01 01  Write data      every 2 bytes are one register value to write
DD           LRC check       LRC check passed

── Technical details ──
Transport: Modbus ASCII (12 decoded bytes)
Slave address: 1
Function: 0x10 (Write Multiple Registers)
Start address: 0 (PLC 40001)
Write quantity: 2
Byte count: 4
Data: 00 0A 01 01
LRC: 0xDD (passed)
PDU: 10 00 00 00 02 04 00 0A 01 01
